name: ncc-workflow
description: Novel Create Center：长篇网文从立书到收束的工作流。下限引擎——书魂与类型契约、五层决策、三本账（承诺/知情/世界）、读者此刻、水章判据、硬伤审；上限引擎——作者种子、人物引擎、场景卡先审故事后写文字、写作简报与质检清单分离、关键节拍写多版由作者挑、三层评价（不打绝对分）、发展编辑、三种写作模式。循环与收束——单元、卷、书三级复盘，卷间闸与完本闸，读者数据回流校准模拟读者，作者可持续与团队认领。每个决策点给推荐与备选，推荐从作者种子长出来。底蕴层——24 张底蕴卡，场景需要时按需派考据顾问出本章知识点清单，有据不编。素材层——作者随手记的生活素材在合适的场景送进写手包，作者自有的代入感与规避点经验进判据，小说底盘作设定底料，拆书拆出质感与机制样本。经理窗口调度十一个创作角色，book.json 单一状态源，写-审-改分离。

description_i18n.en: Novel Create Center: a long-form web-novel workflow from founding to finale. Floor engine — book soul and genre contract, five decision layers, three ledgers (promises / knowledge states / world), reader-now, water-chapter detection, hard-defect review. Ceiling engine — author seeds, character engine, scene cards reviewed for story before any prose, writing briefs kept separate from review checklists, key beats written in several versions for the author to pick, three-layer evaluation with no absolute quality scores, a developmental editor, and architect / gardener / hybrid writing modes. Loops and finale — unit, volume and whole-book reviews, volume and finale gates, real reader data calibrating the simulated reader, author sustainability and team roles. Every decision point offers a recommendation grown from the author's own seeds. Knowledge layer — 24 domain cards and an on-demand knowledge adviser that writes sourced, chapter-specific knowledge lists when scenes need them. Material layer — the author's own observations reach the scenes that need them; the author's notes on immersion and common pitfalls become review criteria; the author's setting base seeds the power system; deconstruction yields texture and social-mechanism samples. A manager window dispatches eleven creative roles over a single book.json state source, with write/review/revise separated.
